articles.title: Can China’s EV boom give it decisive edge in geopolitical tech war?
articles.summary: China's burgeoning electric vehicle industry could serve as a powerful geopolitical tool, enabling the nation to exert influence over countries reliant on its technology and supply chains, fundamentally reshaping global power dynamics. This strategic dominance not only positions China at the forefront of the EV market but also allows it to leverage its technological supremacy in critical geopolitical negotiations.

articles.title: Why US-led alliance might struggle to rein in Beijing’s growing 6G influence
articles.summary: The US-led alliance of 24 countries aims to counter China's expanding influence in the development of 6G technology, yet analysts warn that immediate challenges may hinder its effectiveness in shaping global standards and commercial deployment. This struggle underscores the geopolitical stakes of next-generation technology, which will play a crucial role in future economic and security landscapes.

articles.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
articles.summary: OpenAI's recent adjustments to two API settings have dramatically enhanced GPT-5.6's performance on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, tripling its scores by optimizing reasoning retention and enabling data compaction, a breakthrough that underscores the potential for more efficient and effective AI systems. This advancement not only showcases the power of fine-tuning in AI development but also sets a new standard for future benchmarks in artificial general intelligence.

articles.title: Can the US fend off China’s subsea drones? Its coastguard looks for answers
articles.summary: The U.S. Coast Guard is urgently exploring advanced technologies to detect and neutralize China's rapidly advancing autonomous underwater drones, underscoring a critical vulnerability in American defense capabilities amid escalating maritime tensions. This initiative reflects a significant shift in national security strategy as the U.S. seeks to safeguard its interests against an increasingly sophisticated adversary.

articles.title: US foreign robot ban to benefit Tesla, other American developers, analysts say
articles.summary: The recent U.S. ban on foreign-made advanced robotic devices is poised to significantly advantage American companies like Tesla, as it restricts Chinese robotics firms from entering the U.S. market, thereby fostering domestic innovation and competition in the robotics sector. This strategic move not only strengthens national security but also positions American developers to capitalize on a burgeoning industry with reduced foreign competition.

articles.title: The CXMT shock: how China’s viable alternatives punch Nvidia, Micron, SK Hynix shares
articles.summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is poised to disrupt the semiconductor market with a significant $9.8 billion stock offering aimed at expanding its production of DRAM chips, challenging established giants like Nvidia, Micron, and SK Hynix by providing cost-effective alternatives that could reshape the global AI supply chain. This breakthrough not only signals China's growing influence in technology but also threatens to upend the dominance of foreign tech leaders in a critical industry.

articles.title: How to spot pseudoscience
articles.summary:
• The proliferation of pseudoscience challenges our ability to discern credible knowledge in an age overflowing with information.  
• Critical thinking serves as a vital tool in distinguishing genuine scientific inquiry from misleading claims masquerading as facts.  
• Understanding the scientific method is essential for recognizing the rigorous processes that underpin authentic research.  
• An awareness of cognitive biases can help individuals navigate the seductive allure of pseudoscientific narratives.

articles.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
articles.summary: OpenAI is revolutionizing the landscape of scientific research by providing 100,000 academic researchers with complimentary access to its most advanced AI models, significantly enhancing collaboration and accelerating the pace of discovery across various fields. This groundbreaking initiative promises to transform how researchers generate insights and solve complex problems, potentially leading to unprecedented advancements in science.

articles.title: Chinese AI start-up Moonshot seeks influential ambassadors to widen Kimi’s global reach
articles.summary: Chinese AI start-up Moonshot is launching the "Kimi Ambassador Program" to leverage the impressive performance of its Kimi K3 model, which rivals leading American systems, in a bid to expand its global influence and foster community engagement among developers and creators. This initiative highlights the company's ambition to capitalize on the increasing interest in Kimi K3 and drive widespread adoption in the competitive AI landscape.

articles.title: China should lean into its defining AI advantage – accessibility
articles.summary: China's emerging strength in artificial intelligence lies in its ability to deliver advanced AI solutions at accessible prices, positioning the country to dominate a market where affordability is key to widespread adoption and integration into everyday infrastructure. This shift not only enhances China's competitive edge but also democratizes access to AI technology globally.

articles.title: A new peak in US-China tech rivalry? Tibet drone hub launches on Mount Everest
articles.summary: China's establishment of a drone research hub on Mount Everest underscores a significant escalation in the US-China tech rivalry, as it aims to leverage the region's high-altitude conditions for advanced drone development, potentially reshaping the balance of technological power. This strategic move not only enhances China's military and surveillance capabilities but also signals a bold assertion of its technological ambitions in a critical geopolitical landscape.
